description: This file defines structures, function prototypes, and macros for the internal implementation of git configuration backends in the libgit2 library. It includes definitions for iterators, backend operations, and functions to initialize and add backends.

classes.name: git_config_iterator
classes.description: Iterator structure for traversing git configuration entries, containing a backend pointer, flags, and function pointers for iteration and cleanup.

classes.name: git_config_backend
classes.description: Structure representing a configuration backend with versioning, read-only status, associated config, and function pointers for backend operations such as open, get, set, delete, snapshot, lock, unlock, and free.

methods.name: git_config_init_backend
methods.description: Initializes a git_config_backend structure with default values, setting its version.

methods.name: git_config_add_backend
methods.description: Adds a configuration backend to a git_config object, managing priority and whether to force replace existing backends.
